summary: Faithful port of the official code @ a130281. Every interval and threshold matches arguments/__init__.py and train.py: densify only for 10000<t<20000 every 100; densification stats are masked-loss screen gradients accumulated from step 1 to 19999 (as official, not only during growth); opacity reset only at 15000 and 18000; no size pruning (official passes None); opacity lr 0.025. The mask pipeline also matches: GT DINOv2 features precomputed and render features from the detached full-res render; coarse residual from the images_{4f} render; 7x7 erosion of M>0.25; masked SSIM computed on masked images; MLP Adam 1e-3, with the step deferred to the next call (equivalent order); pause quirk reproduced. Data checks out against the released checkpoints: factors 4/8, clutter/extra splits (crab2 109/194, patio-high 222/45), centred-pp FoV intrinsics, and the crab2 checkpoint reproduces 34.88 exactly. A compressed-schedule run on real patio-high data exercised the densify window, both resets, the pause windows and the coarse->fine switch without error. No critical or major issues.
